comparison.objective: Identify an unliftable carton, shelve the light cartons, and slide the heavy carton to a handoff zone.
comparison.physical_skill: Test lifting, payload inference, feedback adaptation, and safe pushing/placement.
comparison.success_condition: Light cartons rest on the shelf; the test-lifted heavy carton rests on the handoff mat; no drop, tip, or unnecessary handoff.
comparison.reason: Although both adapt from physical feedback, this record classifies payload capacity and routes cartons rather than tuning a mechanism from measured dynamic response.
